blocks.html: This Mother’s Day, we’re going beyond a simple “thank you.” We’re honoring everything that makes Mom extraordinary. From quiet sacrifices to unwavering support, from nurturing dreams to creating a home filled with love—our moms deserve nothing less than the very best. And at Robinsons Malls, we’ve crafted a celebration that’s all about them.
Let her glow inside and out with Jo Malone’s signature scents and Estée Lauder’s iconic beauty essentials at Opus.

Shower her with presents as beautiful and inspiring as she is. Wrap her in the timeless elegance of Jo Malone’s signature scents, or let her glow with the radiance of Estée Lauder’s luxurious skincare and makeup. Give her the gift of rest and self-care with relaxing bath soaks and soothing scents from Yugen—offering her the calm she deserves. Celebrate her unique style with handcrafted pieces from Aranaz, or refresh her favorite spaces with sleek, functional upgrades from Smeg—because, like her, they’re the perfect mix of beauty and purpose. Complete the moment with a vibrant bouquet from Fig & Vine—fresh, heartfelt, and unforgettable.
From handcrafted bags to luxurious bath essentials — gift Mom timeless style and relaxation she can enjoy every day. Visit Yugen at Opus and Robinsons Magnolia and Aranaz at Opus

Make Memories Around the Table
Gather the family for a meal she’ll cherish. Savor the hotpot experience at Hai Di Lao or explore bold flavors at Paradise Dynasty. Share feel-good food and laughter at Nonos and Kitchen by CBTL, sip expertly brewed coffee at St. Ali, and treat her to indulgent sweets from MBakery. Because the best memories are made over good food—with Mom right at the center
Color her world with a bouquet from Fig & Vine at Opus. Enjoy the signature xiao long bao at Paradise Dynasty, soon to open at Robinsons Magnolia.

Experience a Month of Celebration
All month long, Robinsons Malls brings unforgettable experiences just for Mom. From the soulful sounds of RMusicFest featuring Nina, to bonding with her fur babies at Happy Pets Club, to dancing through Active Mom Sundays—every weekend is filled with love and fun. Let her join the thrill of our the Mother’s Day Spin & Win, enjoy a free movie night, or win wellness, dining, and apparel vouchers with a single purchase receipt worth ₱3,000.

Adding to the excitement, the Smart Parenting Mother’s Day Fair on May 10 at Robinsons Galleria’s Main Atrium offers even more ways for moms to feel loved and celebrated. She can relax with wellness clinics, indulge in beauty spa treatments, savor foodie favorites, and create playful memories at the Mommy Playground—a day filled with everything she enjoys most.
Brunch at Kitchen or at St. Ali in Opus — treat Mom to café moments full of flavor and love.

Comfort food, cozy moments, and a sweet ending — treat Mom to her favorites at Nono’s Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Antipolo, and Opus. Indulge in timeless desserts and sweet endings in M Bakery Café and Wildflour at Opus.

At Robinsons Malls, we’re not just offering shopping—we’re creating joyful, shared experiences. From surprise in-mall treats to memory-making moments with the whole family, we’ve built a space where gratitude becomes celebration. This Mother’s Day, don’t just give her a gift—give her a day she’ll never forget.
